comment: What scripts/fetch-engine.sh puts under the download engine, so the bundled app needs nothing from Homebrew. Python is python-build-standalone's relocatable build (https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone), checksum from its release. ffmpeg and ffprobe are Martin Riedl's static arm64 release builds (https://ffmpeg.martin-riedl.de), checksums from the .sha256 files beside them.
